name: iCloud Calendar
description: Read and write Apple iCloud Calendar over CalDAV using an Apple ID and app-specific password. Server-to-server; no macOS required.

appleId.description: Apple Account email address (plain string or ${ENV_VAR})

oneOf.description: App-specific password (plaintext or env interpolation via ${VAR})

appPassword.description: App-specific password from appleid.apple.com: plain string, ${ENV_VAR}, or SecretRef object

timezone.description: IANA time zone used to interpret naive times and format results (default: host time zone)

serverUrl.description: CalDAV server URL (default https://caldav.icloud.com). Must be https.

calendars.description: Optional allowlist of calendar ids or names the agent may see and modify. Empty = all.

readOnly.description: When true, only list/events/get tools are registered; no writes.

appleId.label: Apple ID
appleId.help: The Apple Account email that owns the calendars.

appPassword.label: App-Specific Password
appPassword.help: Generate at appleid.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (two-factor authentication required). Accepts a string, ${ENV_VAR}, or a SecretRef object. Never use your Apple Account password.

calendars.label: Calendar Allowlist
calendars.help: Restrict the agent to these calendar ids or names.
